newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
** Japanese investors were unlikely to review their investment plans in Indonesia over Indonesia's disputed national car policy, a businessman with a large Japanese firm said in Jakarta.
** The Dow Jones industrial index fell 5.22 points at 6,004.78 on Tuesday, the day after it closed above 6,000 for the first time.

** The composite index fell 2.39 points, or 0.42 percent, at 568.59 points on Tuesday on locally-led profit-taking in Astra and limited foreign selling of some heavyweights, including Telkom and Indosat.
** On Wednesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,321.75/22.25 in early trading against an opening of 2,321.50/22.00.
** Glass maker Asahimas on reports the firm had secured shareholder approval to set up a trading firm in Singapore to boost sales in Asia.
** Garment maker Karwell on reports it had secured a licence to produce and sell garments using Walt Disney's trade mark "Pooh."
** Indosat on reports its partly-owned PT Mitra Global Telekomunikasi had signed a $480 million loan to expand telephone lines in Central Java and Jogjakarta.

** Astra on reports that several business tycoons and giant pension funds related with large banks were reported to be interested in selling their stakes to the Nusamba Group, majority owned by foundations controlled by President Suharto.
** Sampoerna on market talk that the tobacco giant founder and president director Putra Sampoerna was likely to sell his holding in Astra to the Nusamba Group.
** Rig Tender on talk the shipping firm was likely to be acquired by a foreign firm. Rig had denied the rumours on Tuesday.
